g.text: 输入手机号与密码，点击登录
ApiService.login() 发送 JSON 请求
显示"登录过于频繁，请30分钟后再试"
提示验证码错误，刷新验证码
HTTP 423 {error: "账户已被锁定，请稍后再试"}
UPDATE users SET failed_login_attempts = 0, account_locked_until = NULL WHERE id = ?
AuthProvider 保存 Token 到内存
UPDATE users SET failed_login_attempts = failed_login_attempts + 1 WHERE id = ?
UPDATE users SET account_locked_until = now() + INTERVAL '30 minutes' WHERE id = ?
HTTP 423 {error: "登录失败次数过多，账户已被锁定 30 分钟"}
